verdict.rationale: dlt provides a well-documented REST API source with declarative config for pagination/auth, plus dlt-init-openapi to generate a custom connector from an OpenAPI spec for any long-tail API, and a low-code AI harness/coding-agent path (not a fork of an existing connector) to scaffold pipelines against 11,200+ sources. This is a first-party framework/builder, not a fork of someone else's connector. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence (beyond vendor docs and one HN thread not about custom connector-building) confirming ease of building long-tail API connectors in practice.
